items.question: Is the app free to download?
items.answer: Yes! The app is free to download on both the App Store and Google Play. A Pro plan is available for users who want access to advanced features.

items.question: Which platforms are supported?
items.answer: The app is available for iOS 13.0+ and Android 8.0+. A web version is coming soon.

items.question: Can I use the app offline?
items.answer: Core features work fully offline. Your data syncs automatically when you reconnect to the internet.

items.question: How do I restore my purchases?
items.answer: Open the app, go to Settings → Subscription, and tap Restore Purchases. Make sure you're signed in with the same account used for the original purchase.

items.question: Is my data private and secure?
items.answer: Absolutely. Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We never sell or share your personal information with third parties. See our Privacy Policy for full details.

items.question: How do I reach support?
items.answer: Tap Help in the app settings or email us at support@example.com. We respond within 24 hours on business days.
